Current learner programs

Each program has its own curriculum, lesson records and progress model.

AB-LPR-EN

ICAO Aviation English

Build speaking and listening skills across pronunciation, structure, vocabulary, fluency, comprehension and interaction. The program includes six modules and 30 published lessons.

What learners can do

  • Work through published lessons by program and module.
  • Use Aviation English practice formats for structured speaking rehearsal.
  • Review learning progress and published resources.
  • Check authority and country references in Requirements.
  • See clearly when a lesson or capability is still coming soon.

In development

Future catalog work covers Air Traffic Controller Knowledge, Maintenance Personnel Licensing, Flight Dispatch Knowledge, Cabin Crew Safety, and UAS and RPAS Operations. These programs are not open for enrolment yet.

Before you enrol

Practice scorecards support rehearsal and do not provide an official language assessment. Country-specific licensing guidance is available for Chile.
